major_cooldowns.name: Fel Devastation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown, syncing it with your Fiery Brand cast when you have Fiery Demise and Down in Flames talented.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id confirmed in all 5 sampled parses; base_cd_s matches the guide's stated 40 second base cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Soul Carver
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown while you have fewer than 3 souls, and sync it with Fiery Brand when you're talented into Fiery Demise.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; base_cd_s matches the guide's stated 1 minute cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Sigil of Spite
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown as long as you won't overcap souls, ideally synced with Fiery Brand when talented into Fiery Demise.

major_cooldowns.name: Metamorphosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown unless you're already in Metamorphosis with more than 5 seconds remaining, since recasting would overwrite rather than extend the duration; try to enter it with maximum souls to get the Spirit Bomb reset.
major_cooldowns.id_note: No base_cd_s row in the abilities table for this id; the 120 second base cooldown comes from the guide's '2 minutes, reduced by some talents' line.

defensives.name: Demon Spikes
defensives.usage_rule: Press it whenever you have no other defensive active, or when its charges would fully recharge before your other active defensives run out.
defensives.id_note: 203819 is the SELF AURA companion id; 203720 is the verified cast id.

defensives.name: Darkness
defensives.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown as much as possible, but hold it for group damage phases, especially multi-hit mechanics or pulls with many adds.

defensives.name: Fiery Brand
defensives.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown, but you can hold it up to 10 seconds for an incoming tankbuster; with Down in Flames talented, sync one charge with your offensive cooldowns.
defensives.id_note: 207771 is the SELF AURA companion id; 204021 is the verified cast id.

defensives.name: Fel Devastation
defensives.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown while below 70% health for the self-heal, syncing it with Fiery Brand when talented into Fiery Demise and Down in Flames.

defensives.name: Metamorphosis
defensives.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown for the damage reduction, but don't recast it while an active Metamorphosis still has more than 5 seconds left, since that overwrites instead of extending the duration.

rules.description: Open with Sigil of Flame, Immolation Aura, Fiery Brand
rules.action: Precast Sigil of Flame, then use Immolation Aura before your first Fiery Brand to get every cooldown rolling with no wasted casts.

rules.description: Hold Soul Carver, Sigil of Spite, Fel Dev for Fiery Brand
rules.action: With Fiery Demise talented, delay these cooldowns a moment so they land while Fiery Brand's debuff is active for the bonus fire damage.
Follow Vengeful Retreat with Felblade immediately to gap-close back onto the target and generate resources for free.

rules.description: Keep Fiery Brand active on your target
rules.action: Recast Fiery Brand the moment its debuff falls off your target instead of letting it lapse.

rules.description: Cast Fel Devastation at high Fury
rules.action: Cast Fel Devastation once you have at least 50 Fury banked.
Press Felblade before your Fury caps out rather than letting it float near max.
Cast Reaver's Glaive as soon as it becomes available to activate the Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry buffs.
